summary: Tested the Instagram (Composio) posting bug fix end-to-end on the backend. New /api/backend/tests/test_instagram_image_hosting.py — 12/12 tests pass, BUT 2 of those tests pin a CRITICAL bug (status 500 instead of 200/410). Findings: (a) GET /api/public/social-image/{img_id} crashes with HTTP 500 `TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes` at server.py:1026 — pymongo/motor decode BSON datetimes as tz-NAIVE while the handler compares with `datetime.now(timezone.utc)` (tz-aware). This breaks the ENTIRE Instagram/Facebook posting fix because Composio fetches that URL and gets 500. (b) The Kubernetes/Cloudflare edge at preview.emergentagent.com rewrites ANY 502 response body into a raw HTML 'preview.emergentagent.com | 502: Bad gateway' page, regardless of the backend's clean JSON body. Therefore `_humanize_provider_error` cleaning is invisible to the user when the backend returns 502 — the user STILL sees `<!DOCTYPE html>...` exactly as originally reported. The fix must use a non-5xx status (200 + `{success:false,error:...}` or 4xx). (c) On the bright side: backend's own JSON detail for 502 is now clean (no raw HTML embedded in the JSON), the data-URI-as-image_url path correctly decodes + hosts publicly, `_host_public_image` writes proper bytes/mime into `public_images` (verified via direct Mongo inspection), scheduled-post endpoint accepts `platforms:['instagram']`, validation 400s work, and PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is a real https URL. (d) Minor: the public-image URL builds correctly (verified by counting new public_images docs before/after an IG POST).

critical.issue: 500 Internal Server Error on EVERY successful lookup. Root cause: server.py:1026 does `exp < datetime.now(timezone.utc)` where `exp` is the BSON-decoded datetime which pymongo/motor returns as tz-NAIVE by default, but `datetime.now(timezone.utc)` is tz-AWARE → `TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes`. Reproduced live with backend traceback. This means Composio fetches the hosted image and receives 500, so Instagram/Facebook never receive the image — the original bug is NOT actually fixed end-to-end. Fix: either (i) at line 1026, normalize via `exp = exp.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) if exp.tzinfo is None else exp` BEFORE the comparison, or (ii) construct the motor client with `tz_aware=True` (e.g., `AsyncIOMotorClient(MONGO_URL, tz_aware=True)`).

When the backend returns HTTP 502 (current behavior on Composio failure), the Kubernetes/Cloudflare edge at preview.emergentagent.com REPLACES the entire response body with its own raw HTML 502 page (`<!DOCTYPE html> ... preview.emergentagent.com | 502: Bad gateway ...`), Content-Type `text/html`. Verified by direct curl: backend on localhost:8001 returns clean JSON with a humanized `detail`; the same call through the public URL returns raw HTML. So `_humanize_provider_error` only ever cleans messages the user never sees. The user-facing original bug ('502: <!DOCTYPE html>...') is therefore NOT fixed. Fix: return 200 with `{success:false, error:'<clean message>'}` (recommended) OR use a 4xx like 409 / 422 / 400 that the edge does NOT rewrite. The frontend `postSocial` parser will need a matching update to read the `success:false` shape.

minor.issue: When `_linkedin_get_author_urn` raises, the handler does `raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail=f"Couldn't read LinkedIn profile: {e}")` without funneling `e` through `_humanize_provider_error`. The text is currently safe (Composio's `ConnectedAccountNotFound` text is plain), but if Composio ever returns an HTML error (Cloudflare/edge), it will leak verbatim. Recommendation: route this through `_humanize_provider_error` like the main success-check branch does.

Inserts `expires_at` as a tz-aware datetime, but on read-back it becomes tz-naive (BSON quirk). Same datetime-tz inconsistency that triggers the critical bug. Centralized fix should be on the read side.

integration_issues.issue: Even if a user had a linked Instagram Business account, posting would fail because Composio fetches the hosted image URL and the backend returns 500 (datetime tz bug). End-to-end IG posting is BROKEN until critical bug #1 is fixed.

action_items: [CRITICAL] Fix datetime tz bug in /app/backend/server.py:1026. Minimal patch: replace `if isinstance(exp, datetime) and exp < datetime.now(timezone.utc):` with `if isinstance(exp, datetime):\n    exp_utc = exp if exp.tzinfo is not None else exp.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)\n    if exp_utc < datetime.now(timezone.utc):` — and similarly the cleanup after. OR initialize the motor client with `tz_aware=True`. Verify by re-running test_valid_id_returns_png_with_correct_mime (currently asserts 500 — flip to 200) and test_expired_id_returns_410 (currently 500 → flip to 410).

[CRITICAL] Stop returning HTTP 502 for Composio/provider failures because the preview edge rewrites the body to raw HTML — the user sees `<!DOCTYPE html>` exactly as in the original bug. Pick ONE: (a) return `200 OK` with `{success:false, error:'<clean>'}` in social_post (server.py:1290-1394) and update the frontend `postSocial` in /app/frontend/app/generate/[type].tsx to check `data.success === false`; OR (b) use HTTP 409 / 422 (a 4xx) which the edge passes through. Same change needed in `_execute_social_post` for the scheduler.
[MEDIUM] Funnel the URN-failure path in social_post (server.py:1300) through `_humanize_provider_error` so any future HTML-from-Composio also gets cleaned.

[LOW] Add a unit test (offline) that asserts `_humanize_provider_error('<!DOCTYPE html>...502 Bad gateway...', 'instagram')` returns the friendly 'temporarily unreachable' message — currently relies on Composio raising a string that contains those tokens.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1026 — naive-vs-aware datetime compare → 500 on every successful image fetch. This single line completely defeats the Instagram fix; please patch before merging.

server.py:1290-1394 — 502 status code for provider failures is the WRONG status for this hosting environment because the edge rewrites 5xx bodies. Either change to 200+`success:false` (preferred — matches how _execute_social_post already returns) or use a 4xx.
server.py:1300 — direct `raise HTTPException(502, f"Couldn't read LinkedIn profile: {e}")` bypasses the new HTML-stripping cleaner.
server.py is now 1709 lines (>700-line guideline). Suggest splitting social/* and public_images/* into their own router modules.

success_rate.backend: 10/12 endpoints behave as required (83%). 2/12 endpoints (GET public/social-image happy-path + expired-path) currently 500 instead of 200/410 due to the datetime tz bug. The IG posting endpoint returns clean JSON internally but the edge rewrites the 502, so user-facing the original bug remains.

rca_of_issue: ORIGINAL USER BUG: 'Instagram post via Composio returns 502: <!DOCTYPE html>...'. The dev fixed PART OF THE CAUSE (data-URI being passed downstream) by adding `_host_public_image` and an `_humanize_provider_error` cleaner. However, two follow-on issues completely block the fix from reaching the user: (A) The hosted-image endpoint returns 500 because pymongo decodes BSON dates as tz-naive but the comparison uses tz-aware. Composio's image fetcher will therefore receive 500 and the IG post will fail. (B) Even with a clean backend JSON 502, the preview-environment edge (Cloudflare / k8s ingress) intercepts ALL 5xx and replaces the body with raw HTML. So even if the image hosting worked, when ANY provider error occurs the user sees `<!DOCTYPE html>` again — exactly the original symptom. REPRODUCTION: direct curl POST https://rep-daily-ai.preview.emergentagent.com/api/social/linkedin/post returns Content-Type text/html with `<!DOCTYPE html>` body, while the SAME call to http://localhost:8001 returns clean JSON with the cleaned `detail`. MITIGATION (must do both): (1) Patch server.py:1026 datetime compare (or set `tz_aware=True` on the motor client). (2) Change social_post to return HTTP 200 with `{success:false, error:...}` shape on provider failure (matches `_execute_social_post`'s scheduler shape) and update frontend `postSocial` accordingly.
